cues: Joining sentences, the patterns NEB sets.
The tea was very hot; I could not drink it.
With so that: the tea was so hot that I could not drink it.
With too to: the tea was too hot to drink.
With although: although he was tired, he finished.
With unless: unless you work hard, you will fail.
With in spite of, turn the clause into a noun: in spite of his illness.
And with so that for purpose: she got up early so that she could catch the first bus.
